a.lede: Following the string of cyberattacks on supermarket freezers, blood banks in France were recently attacked. Luckily, no biomaterial was lost as the attack triggered the EFS' alerts.
a.title: Hackers target French blood service fridges following supermarket attacks

b.lede: Supermarkets in countries including Ireland, Sweden and Belgium reported fridges being hiked in temperature on Monday.
b.title: UK meat industry hit by cyber-attack which targeted European supermarket freezers
